releaseNotes: Team page cleanup: My Teams hub card with Add Team; each team gets its own card in theme-palette colors showing its win-loss record, with Roster & Lineup and Team Stats buttons. Roster page edits roster, lineup and walk-up music as before; Team Stats page has win-loss, member stats and tappable game history. Scoreboards: traditional inning linescore with runs and hits at the far right and no errors column, as decided. Share button on the live scoreboard, on team-history games and on matching Games History entries sends the board as text. Inning-by-inning scoring is recorded from this update on; older games show totals only. No other gameplay changes.
